<entry id="S01402">
<head-word>קָלַף</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. גָּלַף) 
<italic>to scrape, peel, pare</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. VII, 2 (75
<sup>b</sup>) יִקְלוֹף את מקומו (Bab. ed. יְקַלֵּף) let him pare off the place where it touched the wall of the stove. Ib. 3 יקלוף את החיצון let him pare off the surface. Tosef. Neg. VI, 8 היה קוֹלֵף וכ' he scraped off the sand (cement) between one stone and another; a. fr.—Part. pass. קָלוּף; f. קְלוּפָה &c. Nidd. 17
<sup>a</sup> שום ק' … וביצה ק' וכ' peeled garlic, peeled onions or peeled eggs … which were let lie over night. Bicc. III, 8 ערבה ק' peeled willow twigs; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>קִילֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> same. Maasr. IV, 5 שעורים מקלף וכ'(ב) המְקלֵּף (Mish. ed. המקליף, corr. acc.) he who husks barley-corns (to eat them before tithes are given), must husk each singly and eat; Bets. 13
<sup>b</sup>. Y. Maasr. II, 50
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. B. Mets. VII, beg. 11
<sup>b</sup> שלא יְקַלֵּף, v. 
<xref rid="M02335">מִצְמֵץ</xref>. Lam. R. introd. (R. Yoḥ. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes>; Cant. R. to VIII, 4 מלאך היה יורד ומְקַלְּפוֹ an angel came down and scraped the Divine Name off. Sot. 35
<sup>b</sup> וקִילְּפוּ את הסיד they scraped the lime off (which covered the inscription); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נֵקְלָף, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְקַלֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be peeled off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lam. R. l. c.; Cant. R. l. c. מאליו היה נ' it (the Divine Name) was erased of itself. Ḥull. III, 5, v. קוֹיְקְבָן. Ib. 49
<sup>b</sup> מה חלב … קרום ונ' וכ' as ‘the fat that covers the inwards’ has a skin which can be peeled off, so all fat with a skin that can be peeled off (is forbidden), v. תּוֹתָב; a. e.—Kel. X, 5 חבית שנִתְקַלְּפָה וכ' an earthen jug which is peeled off (crumbled away), the pitch lining standing by itself; Tosef. ib. B. Kam. VII, 8 [read:] נתקלפה והזפת וכ'.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01403">
<head-word>קְלַף</head-word>
<head-word>קְלֵיף</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Joel I, 7; a. e.—Part. pass. קָלִיף. Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 11.—Gen. R. s. 82 (ref. to Jer. XLIX, 10) קַלְפִית בצלייה Ar. (ed. קליפת בצלים, ref. to Ob. 6, corr. acc.) I stripped the onions (laid bare Esau’s corruption); Yalk. Jer. 332 קְלִיפִית (not קליפות); Yalk. Chr. 1073 (corr. acc.). Gen. R. s. 95, end, v. 
<xref rid="B00313">בּוּצְלָא</xref>. Cant. R. to III, 4 (expl. חשפי שבל, Is. XLVII, 2) קְלוֹפִי סובלתא דנהרא (v. שׁוּבַּלְתָּא) lay bare (the bed of) the current of the river (dig channels to divert the river from its course). Bets. 14
<sup>b</sup> קָלִיף וכ', v. צִיהֲרָא; a. e.—B. Bath. 4
<sup>b</sup>, v. קְפַל II.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>קַלֵּף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Gen. XXX, 37 (Y. קְלֵף 
<italic>Pe.</italic>). Ib. 38. Targ. II Kings XVIII, 16; a. e.—Part. pass. מְקַלַּף 
<italic>peeling, flaky</italic>. Targ. O. Ex. XVI, 14 (h. text מחספס).—Bets. 13
<sup>b</sup> מְקַלְּפָא ליה וכ' his wife husked (barley) for him by the cupfuls. Ḥull. 62
<sup>b</sup> לא … מְקַלַּף וכ' its craw could not be peeled.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְקַלַּף, אִיקַּלַּף, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיקְּלִיף</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be peeled, stripped, scraped off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. XI, 13 מִקְּלִיף (not מַקְ').—Ḥull. l. c. לא מִקְּלִיף וכ' could be peeled with a knife only. Y. Snh. IV, 22
<sup>b</sup> top, v. מַרְקוֹעַ II. M. Kat. 13
<sup>b</sup> כגון דמִיקַּלְּפָּן when the grains are husked; אי לאו … מִיקַּלְּפָא if they had not steeped them in water, the husking could not have been done (differ. in Ms. M., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<sense>

<italic>pl.</italic>) 
<italic>scales; scaly shield</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. O. Lev. XI, 9; Deut. XIV, 9, sq. (ed. Berl. ק'). Targ. Job XLI, 7 קְלִפוֹהִי Ms. (missing in ed.; h. text מגנים).—Snh. 110
<sup>a</sup> קִילְפֵי (Ms. M. קוּלְפֵי) the scaly (metal) rims of bags; Pes. 119
<sup>a</sup> קליפא (Rashi קִלּוּפֵי), v. קוּפְלָא I. Keth. 65
<sup>a</sup> מחתא לה בקולפי דשידא she struck her with the metal straps of a chest (v. קוּלְפָא).—[Yalk. Ez. 362 קילפא, v. קוּלְפָא.—Y. Sabb. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup> bot. קְלִיפַיָּיא, v. קְלוּפִיתָא.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>קַלְפִּי</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (κάλπη) 
<italic>urn for drawing lots</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Lev. XVI, 8 (not קְלַפֵּי).—Tosef. Yoma III (II), 1; Yoma IV, 1 טרף בק' he shook the urn. Ib. III, 9 וק' היתה וכ' an urn was there (in the Temple) containing two lots. Y. ib. IV, beg. 41
<sup>b</sup> לא סוף דבר ק' וכ' it was not at all necessary to use an urn, a basket might have served the purpose; but why did they say, ‘an urn’?, v. פּוֹמְפִּי. B. Bath. 122
<sup>a</sup> ק' של שבטים an urn containing the names of the tribes; ק' של תחומין an urn containing the names of the districts (to be allotted); Num. R. s. 21; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קַלְפִּיּוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Yoma l. c. בשתי ק' וכ' by means of two urns the land of Israel was divided, v. supra.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01415">
<head-word>קִלְקֵל</head-word>
<head-word>קִילְקֵל</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קָלַל, cmp. קְלַק) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to upset, disarrange, damage, ruin</italic>, opp. תקן.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 98 ק' את היצועין upset the couches. Ḥull. 8
<sup>a</sup> מותר … מְקַלְקֵל הוא it is permitted to slaughter with a knife belonging to idolatrous service, because slaughtering is doing damage (a living animal being more useful than a dead one). Sabb. XIII, 3 כל המְקַלְקְלִין פטורין all those who perform an act (on the Sabbath) by which they do ruin, are exempt (from sin-offering); והמקלקל ע"מ לתקן וכ' but he that undoes a thing for the purpose of reconstructing it is guilty. Keth. 5
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (with or sub. מעשה = b. h. הִשְׁחִית) 
<italic>to be corrupt, to disgrace one’s self by immorality</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. I, end, 64
<sup>d</sup> חם … קִילְקְלוּ מעשיהן Ham, the dog, and the raven acted mischievously (by sexual connection in the ark, v. Snh. 108
<sup>b</sup>; Gen. R. s. 36). R. Hash. 12
<sup>a</sup> ברותחין קלקלו וכ' with heat (of passion) they sinned, and with hot waters they were punished; Snh. 108
<sup>b</sup>. Tosef. Sot. II, 2 אפי' תְקַלְקֵל וכ', v. עָרַר; a. fr.—[Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, ed. Bub. note 69 קלקלתי, v. כִּלְכֵּל.]—Part. pass. מְקוּלְקָל; f. מְקוּלְקֶלֶת; 
<italic>pl</italic>. מְקוּלְקָלִים, מְקוּלְקָלִין; מְקוּלְקָלוֹת. M. Kat. I, 2 (2
<sup>a</sup>) ומתקנין את המקולקלת Y. a. Bab. ed. (Mish. המקולקלות, incorr.) and you may mend a channel that is out of order during the festive week. Snh. 39
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ez. V, 7) כמתוקנין … כמק' שבהם עשיתן you did not do according to the good usages among them, but according to their corrupt usages. B. Bath. 109
<sup>b</sup>, v. קַלְקָלָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to sharpen</italic>; trnsf. (cmp. חָדַד, שָׁנַן) 
<italic>to repeat, study</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Koh. R. to X, 10 אם נקהה … קַלְקֵל עליו בחילך if thy lesson is as tough to thee as iron (v. קָהָה), and … none is on hand to explain it to thee, go over it studying with thy own strength.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְקַלְקֵל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְקַלְקֵל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be disarranged, ruined, spoiled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>c</sup> bot. נִתְקַלְקְלוּ חשבונותיו וכ' his dates were disarranged, and he said, let this begin a new era; נתקלקלו לשעבר the dates were disarranged (confused) with regard to the events of the past, v. קִילְקוּל. Dem. III, 6, v. חָלַף. Y. Shek. VII, 50
<sup>c</sup> נִתְקַלְקְלָה צורתן (not נתקלקה), v. צוּרָה; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="S01255">קָלָה I</xref>) 
<italic>to commit a nuisance, to collapse under the influence of corporal punishment</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 286; Macc. III, 14; a. e.—[Bekh. 8
<sup>a</sup> נתקלקל, v. קָלַל.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01416">
<head-word>קַלְקֵל</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>
<italic>to ruin</italic> &c. Targ. Is. III, 12 (h. text בלע). Targ. Jer. II, 36 (h. text שנה). Targ. II Sam. XV, 31 (h. text סכל). Targ. II Chr. XXVII, 2 (h. text השחית).—Part. pass. מְקַלְקַל; f. מְקַלְקְלָא; 
<plural-form>pl. מְקַלְקְלִין, מְקַלְקְלַיָּא; מְקַלְקְלָתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Esth. V, 1 הוות מק' was soiled. Targ. Job XXIX, 17 Ms. (ed. מְקַלְקִל; h. text עַוָּל). Targ. Koh. IV, 12. Targ. Zech. I, 4. Targ. Jud. II, 19; a. e.—Yeb. 119
<sup>b</sup>, sq. היא לא מְקַלְקְלָא נפשה she is not likely to injure her own case (by a false statement). Ib. לקַלְקָלָא לצרה היא וכ' she has the intention of injuring the case of her rival. Lev. R. s. 37 מְקַלְקְלֵי they ruin (play with), v. מְיַנּוֹק.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpalp.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְקַלְקֵל, אִיקַּ'</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be disarranged, corrupted, ruined</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Jer. XLIX, 7. Targ. Y. Lev. XVII, 13 מִתְקַלְקְלָא ניכסתיה its slaughtering was ruined (illegal through faulty manipulation). Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 21 מִיקּ' בניכסא made unfit through faulty slaughtering; a. e.—Erub. 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. אתי עירוב לאִיקַּלְקוּלֶי the practice of ʿErub (v. עֵירוּב) may come to harm (get into disuse); a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01419">
<head-word>קַלְקָלָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (קִלְקֵל) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>degradation, disgrace</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. IV, 18 אל … בשעת קַלְקָלָתוֹ do not strive to see thy neighbor at the moment of his disgrace. Hor. III, 7 (13
<sup>a</sup>) בזמן ששניהם עומדים לק' (Bab. ed. בק') when both (a man and a woman) are exposed to disgrace (prostitution, v. קָלוֹן). Gen. R. s. 20 בק' מתחילים וכ' in degradation (punishment) the beginning is made with the lowest, opp. גדולה elevation; Sifra Sh’mini, Milluim; Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> Ms. M. (ed. בקללה); Taan. 15
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>corruption, degeneration, sin, mischief</italic>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> קְנֵה מנורה; Y. ib. XII, 13
<sup>c</sup> קְנֵי. Ib. ק' של ציידין a part of the composite pole which the hunters use (to reach the nests); Bab. l. c. קְ' סיידין of the whitewashers; Tosef. l. c. ציידין (Var. ס'). Ker. 5
<sup>a</sup> קְנֵה בשם sweet calamus. Kel. XVII, 16 קְ' מאזניים the beam of the balance. Ib. ק' של עני וכ' the poor man’s cane which has a receptacle for water.—דחה בק', v. דָּחָה.—Ber. 61
<sup>a</sup> bot. ק' מוציא קול the windpipe produces sound. Ḥull. 21
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 65
<sup>b</sup> עד שמגיע … לק' until he reaches (with his nail) the gullet or the windpipe. Ḥull. 28
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) נבדקיה לק' וכ' let him examine the windpipe and cut it &c. Men. XI, 6 עשרים … כחצי ק' חלול twenty-eight staves shaped like a segment of a hollow reed; a. fr.—Ohol. I, 8 ק' = קְנֵה זרוע 
<italic>forearm</italic>.—קְנֵה שפה, v. קָמָה.—הושיט בק' [
<italic>to hold forth on a cane</italic>,] 
<italic>to treat lightly, consider unimportant</italic>. Num. R. s. 8 end דבר … והושיטו לו בק' (not והושיטה) something for which that ancestor prostrated himself in prayer (Gen. XXVIII, 20) …, and now comes this man (Aquila) and holds it up to contempt!; Yalk. Gen. 123; Gen. R. s. 70. Ib. את מושיטו לזה בק' dost thou make it appear contemptible to this man?; Koh. R. to VII, 8.—

I, 1 המְקַנֵּא … מקנא לה על פי שנים he who suspects his wife … must bring charges against her based on a warning given in the presence of two witnesses. Zuck. המְקַנֶּה, Var. מקנה) he who wants to proceed against his wife, must bring charges based on a statement of warning by one witness or on his own statement; Sot. 2

<sup>a</sup> אסור לקַנְּאוֹת it is forbidden to warn one’s wife (in the presence of witnesses). Ib. 3
<sup>a</sup> מותר לק' it is permitted &c. M. Kat. 18
<sup>b</sup> (ref. to Ps. CVI, 16) שכל … קי' לאשתו ממשה every one of them warned his wife in jealousy of Moses. Num. R. s. 9 ע"י איש הוא מקנה אותה וכ' he may bring charges on the ground of suspicious conduct towards a man (human being) but not &c. Ib. בית רין מְקַנְּאִין להם וכ' (some ed. מְקַנִּין) the court takes proceedings in their (the husbands’) behalf &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to arouse jealousy; to provoke</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Meg. 15
<sup>b</sup> קִנְּאַתּוּ במלך וכ' she (by inviting Haman) aroused against him the jealousy of the king and the jealousy of the (other) princes. Num. R. l. c. שהיא מְקַנְּאָה להקב"ה וכ' for she provokes the Lord and her husband; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>

<entry id="S01568">
<head-word>קני</head-word>
<head-word>קָנָה</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) [
<italic>to establish</italic>,] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (cmp. קום, Gen. XXIII, 17) 
<italic>to create; to acquire, own; to take possession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. 31
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Ps. XXIV recited in the Temple on the first day of the week) על שם שק' והקנה וכ' because he (the Lord in establishing the world) took possession and gave (his creatures) possession (invested them with a fief), and became the sovereign of the world. Kidd. I, 1 האשה קוֹנָה את עצמה וכ' a wife acquires herself (becomes independent) when she receives her divorce &c. Ib. 20
<sup>a</sup> כל הקוֹנֶה … כקונה וכ' whoever buys a Hebrew bondman creates, as it were, a master over himself. B. Mets. 75
<sup>b</sup> הקונה אדון לעצמו he who creates a master over himself, expl. תולה נכסיו בנכרי who (in order to evade obligations) hangs his property on a gentile (pretends to be merely the agent of a gentile); (another explan.) הכותב נכסיו וכ' who transfers his property to his children during his lifetime. Gitt. 37
<sup>b</sup> sq. (ref. to Lev. XXV, 45) אתם קוֹנִים וכ' you may buy (as a slave) one of them, but they cannot buy one of you, nor can they buy of one another. Ib. יכול לא יִקְנוּ זה את זה למעשה ידיו you may think, they cannot buy one another for the work (as long as the serf choses to be in the master’s power); ולא הם קוֹנִים … לגופו they cannot buy of one another a bodily slave (who requires formal manumission to be a freeman). B. Mets. 46
<sup>b</sup> bot. מכור לי באלו ק' if one says, sell me (a certain object) for these (coins which I hold in my hand), he has bought (the sale is valid). Ib. IV, 1 הזהב קונה וכ', v. זָהָב. Ib. מעות הרעות קוֹנוֹת וכ' the delivery of cancelled coins effects the purchase of the valid coins. Ib. 47
<sup>b</sup> מעות קונות the delivery of the purchasing money gives possession (no formal possession of the purchased object (מְשִׁיכָה) being required). Kidd. 22
<sup>b</sup> הגבהה קונה lifting up the purchased object makes the sale binding; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make sure; to obligate a person by a special symbolical act</italic> (קִנְיָן); 
<italic>to enter into an obligation by a special symbolical form</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 51
<sup>a</sup> בשקָנוּ מידו when they (the court, witnesses &c.) made him obligate himself (that his widow should receive support from his estate); בשקנו לזו ולא קנו לזו when such an obligation was entered with reference to this (his wife’s case), but not with reference to that (his daughter’s case). B. Mets. 47
<sup>a</sup> במה קונין … בכליו של קונה wherewith is the bargain made sure?… By handing over one of the garments (or any object) belonging to the purchaser; דניחא ליה לקונה דליהוי מקנה קונה וכ' for the purchaser likes the seller to obligate himself, in order that he may be sure to give him possession; a. fr.—Ib. 48
<sup>b</sup> when he said to him, ערבוני יָקוּן (fr. קון = קנה) my earnest money shall serve to make the purchase sure.—Part. pass. קָנוּי; f. קְנוּיָה; 
<plural-form>pl. קְנוּיִים, קְנוּיִין; קְנוּיוֹת</plural-form>. Kidd. 16
<sup>a</sup> עבד עברי גופו ק' והרב וכ' a Hebrew bondman is owned bodily (to the end of his term), and if the master allowed him a reduction of his time, his allowance is not legally binding (the slave not being able to acquire himself); ib. 28
<sup>a</sup>; B. Kam. 113
<sup>b</sup>. Gen. R. s. 86 (ref. to Gen. XXXIX, 1) הקנויין קונין וכל וכ' as a rule those who are owned make themselves owners (slaves enrich themselves by robbing their master), and all slaves cause decrease to their master’s house, but in this case ‘the Lord blessed &c.’ (ib. 5); Yalk. ib. 145 הקונין קונין (corr. acc.); a. fr.—Tosef. Ned. IV, 6 קונם … שאני קנוי the axe of which I am possessed be forbidden (v. קוֹנָם), i.e. I swear that I have no axe; Ned. 35
<sup>a</sup> (Rashi שאינו ק' I swear that another axe is not owned by me).—[Y. Peah IV, 18
<sup>b</sup> השעה קנויה, read: פְּנוּיָה, v. פָּנוּי.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִקְנֶה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be acquired, owned, bought</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 20
<sup>a</sup> (ref. to Lev. XXV, 14) דבר הנ' מיד ליד this refers to what is bought from hand to hand (movable goods). Ib. I, 1 האשה נִקְנֵית וכ' a wife can be acquired in three ways. Ib. 6
<sup>b</sup> אין אשה נ' בחליפין a wife cannot be taken possession of by symbolical delivery (חֲלִיפִין). Ib. I, 3 עבד כנעני נ' בכסף וכ' a Canaanite slave is taken possession of (is considered owned) either by delivery of the purchasing money, or by a deed, or by undisturbed possession (חֲזָקָה). Ib. 5 נכסים שיש … נִקְנִין וכ' landed property is acquired by means of handing over the money &c., but movables cannot be acquired otherwise than by taking hold (מְשִׁיכָה). Ib. 22
<sup>b</sup> תִּקָּנֶה בביאה let her be acquired (become his slave) by coition; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִקְנָה</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to give possession, sell, transfer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> R. Hash. l. c., v. supra. Snh. 81
<sup>b</sup> ולמַקְנוֹ, v. קוֹנֶה. Keth. 82
<sup>b</sup> אשה הִקְנוּ לו וכ' it is heaven that gave him a wife (through his brother’s death without issue); Yeb. 39
<sup>a</sup>. B. Mets. 47
<sup>a</sup> בכליו של מַקְנֶה, v. supra. Ib. 33
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אין אדם מקנה דבר וכ' none can give possession of (sell) what does not yet exist (future crops &c.); a. fr.—Esth. R. introd. (ref. to Deut. XXVIII, 68 sq.) למה ואין קונה … ע"י שלא הִקְנִיתֶם אלה וכ' why ‘no purchaser’?… Because you have not transmitted ‘these words of the covenant’, for there is none among you making the five books of the Law his own (v. קוֹנֶה).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition />

<sup>b</sup> דקְנָאִי ודקָנִינָא which I have acquired (own), and which I may acquire in the future. B. Bath. 44
<sup>b</sup> דאִיקְנֵי קנה וכ' if the document reads ‘that which I may obtain’ (shall be seizable for my debt), and be bought and sold again …, it cannot be seized; ib. 157
<sup>a</sup>. Ib. 168

<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make one a bondman</italic>.</definition>
<notes>. Targ. Zech. XIII, 5.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to give possession, sell</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Chr. XXI, 3.—B. Bath. 44
<sup>b</sup> אי א' … אגב וכ' if he gave him possession of movable 
<pgbrk id="pg1392" />chattel by dint of immovables jointly sold (v. אַגַּב) &c. B. Mets. 72
<sup>a</sup> אַקְנְיֵיה לבנו וכ' he signed it over to his minor son. Kidd. 7
<sup>a</sup> מַקְנְיָא נפשה she may give possession of herself (become his wife); a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִיקְּנֵי</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be obtained, acquired</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 77
<sup>a</sup> מִיקְּנִין (Rashb. מִיקְּנוּ), v. מִילָּא II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="S01570">
<head-word>קָנֵי</head-word>
<head-word>קַנְיָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, constr. קְנֵי = h. קָנֶה, 
<italic>reed, stalk, branch</italic>, &c. Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 31 (some ed. קָנַיָּא 
<italic>pl.</italic>).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XIX, 6 (ed. Lag. קנה). Targ. II Kings XVIII, 21.—Targ. Ex. XXX, 23 (some ed. קנה).—Targ. Ez. XL, 3. Ib. XLI, 8 (not קָנַיָא). Targ. Ex. XXV, 31 (ed. Vien. קְנַה); a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 6 נטל חד קנה וכ' he took a cane and made a cavity in it into which he put those Denars; א"ל צור הדין ק' בידך וכ' he said to him, hold this cane in thy hand while I am being sworn; נסתיה לקָנֵיה וכ' he took his cane and knocked it to the ground &c.; Ned. 25

<plural-form>Pl. קָנִין, קָנַיָּא, קָנֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Ex. XXV, 33. Targ. II Esth. I, 2; a. e.—Ḥull. 53
<sup>b</sup> על לביני ק' went among the reeds. Ib. 45
<sup>b</sup> תלתא ק' הוו there are three branches (of the windpipe), one branches off towards &c.; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="S01578">

<entry id="S01587">
<head-word>קִנְיָן</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> קָנָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>purchase, ownership, right of possession</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 47
<sup>b</sup> יש ק' לנכרי בא"י וכ' a gentile has the right of possession in Palestine inasmuch as his produces are exempt from tithes. Ib. קִנְיַן פירות כק' הגוף דמי the acquisition of usufruct is like the acquisition of the soil itself (and the Jewish owner of the usufruct has to offer the first fruits as if he were the owner of the land). Gitt. I, 6 מפני שהוא קִנְיָנוֹ (Y. ed. קִנְיָינוֹ) because he (the slave) is his property. Esth. R. introd. (ref. to Lev. XXV, 45) אתם יש לכם ק' וכ' you have the right of possession (of slaves) of the nations, but the nations have no right of possession of you, v. קָנָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>property</italic>, esp. 
<italic>cattle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 22 הפרישו … בשביל קִנְיָנָם they separated themselves from their brethren for the sake of their cattle; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>affirmation, making sure; symbolical form of making an agreement binding</italic>, by handing over an object from one to the other of the contracting parties (v. 
<xref rid="S01533">קָנָה</xref> 2).</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 40
<sup>a</sup> ק' בפני שנים ואינו … כתיבו 
<pgbrk id="pg1393" />an agreement by symbol is made in the presence of two (forming a court), nor is it then necessary to say, ‘write’, i.e. a document is made out without special authorization. Ib. סתם ק' לכתיבה עומד an agreement by symbol, unless otherwise stipulated, is intended to be written out. Ib. 3
<sup>a</sup> ק' דברים בעלמא חוא it is merely an agreement on words (no transfer of a tangible object being agreed upon); a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. קִנְיָנִים, קִנְיָנִין, קִנְיָי'</plural-form>. Pes. 87
<sup>b</sup> אחד מארבעה ק' שקניתי בעולמי one of the four possessions which I own in my world. Sifré Deut. 309 (ref. to Deut. XXXII, 6) ק' אתם לי וכ' (not זקנים) you are to me an acquired property, and not an inheritance. Ab. ch. VI; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>
